shortDescription: This module is to read, add, and delete inventory (FTD, ASA, IOS devices) on Cisco Defense Orchestrator (CDO).

options.name: add
options.description: This option onboards an FTD, ASA, or IOS device to be managed by CDO

options.name: api_key
options.description: This is the CDO tenant's API token.

options.name: delete
options.description: This option removes an FTD, ASA, or IOS device from CDO and cdFMC if relevant.

options.name: gather
options.description: This option gathers inventory information from CDO and returns things like serial number, code version, uptime, etc.

options.name: region
options.description: This is the CDO region where the tenant exists.
